meta.project: CareGate Healthcare Ecosystem Platform (Haya Bila Alam — حياة بلا ألم)

product_overview: CareGate is a multi-stakeholder digital healthcare operating system for patients, doctors, and healthcare operations teams. It combines identity, appointments, EMR, insurance, payments, communication, support, and medical record access through a versioned backend API.
core_goals: Provide secure patient onboarding with OTP-based authentication and JWT sessions
Enable patients to manage profiles, family members, insurance, and medical history
Support doctor discovery and appointment booking for self or family members
Orchestrate telemedicine, chat, prescriptions, reports, lab tests, and call sessions around appointments
Track insurance policies, pre-authorization requests, and insurance decision status
Support direct and insurance-backed payments, home services, and booking history
Expose medical records, files, notifications, support tickets, and settings through patient APIs

features.name: Patient Auth
features.description: Handles patient registration, login, OTP verification, token refresh, password recovery, session management, and account deletion.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/patient/auth/register with valid patient details -> Receive 201 with OTP challenge created -> POST /api/v1/patient/auth/verify-otp with correct OTP 12345 -> Receive 200 with accessToken and refreshToken -> GET /api/v1/patient/auth/me with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with current patient profile

POST /api/v1/patient/auth/login with valid phoneNumber and password -> Receive 200 with accessToken and refreshToken -> POST /api/v1/patient/auth/refresh-token with refreshToken -> Receive 200 with new accessToken pair -> POST /api/v1/patient/auth/logout with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 confirming session ended

POST /api/v1/patient/auth/login with invalid password -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/patient/auth/me without Bearer token -> Receive 401 authentication required -> POST /api/v1/patient/auth/verify-otp with incorrect OTP -> Receive 400 or 401 invalid verification code

features.name: Patient Profile
features.description: Allows authenticated patients to view and update personal profile information such as name, language, and contact details.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/profile with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with profile data -> PUT /api/v1/patient/profile with updated personal details -> Receive 200 with saved profile -> GET /api/v1/patient/profile -> Receive 200 with updated values

GET /api/v1/patient/profile without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> PUT /api/v1/patient/profile with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/profile with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 when partial update is valid

features.name: Medical Catalog
features.description: Provides authenticated access to master lists of chronic diseases and medications for patient medical profile selection.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/medical-catalog/chronic-diseases with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with chronic disease catalog -> GET /api/v1/patient/medical-catalog/medications with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with medication catalog

GET /api/v1/patient/medical-catalog/chronic-diseases without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/patient/medical-catalog/medications with invalid token -> Receive 401 invalid token

features.name: Medical Profile
features.description: Lets patients manage their EMR profile, including chronic diseases, medications, attachments, and linked medical history.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/medical-profile with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with current medical profile -> PUT /api/v1/patient/medical-profile with chronicDiseaseIds and medicationIds -> Receive 200 with updated profile -> GET /api/v1/patient/medical-profile/attachments -> Receive 200 with uploaded attachment list

POST /api/v1/patient/medical-profile/attachments with multipart file and Bearer accessToken -> Receive 201 attachment created -> GET /api/v1/patient/medical-profile -> Receive 200 showing attachment reference

GET /api/v1/patient/medical-profile without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> PUT /api/v1/patient/medical-profile with invalid catalog IDs -> Receive 400 validation or not-found error -> POST /api/v1/patient/medical-profile/attachments with unsupported file type -> Receive 400 file validation error

features.name: Medical Timeline
features.description: Returns an aggregated timeline of patient clinical events, such as appointments, records, lab results, and prescriptions.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/medical-timeline with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with ordered timeline events
GET /api/v1/patient/medical-timeline without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/patient/medical-timeline with expired token -> Receive 401 token expired or invalid

features.name: Family Members
features.description: Allows patients to create and manage dependent family profiles for proxy booking and family-based appointments.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/family-members with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with family member list -> POST /api/v1/patient/family-members with valid dependent data -> Receive 201 family member created -> PUT /api/v1/patient/family-members/:id with updated details -> Receive 200 saved changes -> DELETE /api/v1/patient/family-members/:id -> Receive 200 or 204 deleted

GET /api/v1/patient/family-members without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/v1/patient/family-members with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> PUT /api/v1/patient/family-members/:id for a non-owned member -> Receive 404 or 403 access denied

features.name: Insurances
features.description: Manages patient insurance providers, policy records, and policy lifecycle used during direct or insured bookings.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/insurances/providers with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with insurance provider catalog -> GET /api/v1/patient/insurances -> Receive 200 with current patient policies -> POST /api/v1/patient/insurances with providerId, policyNumber, and card image -> Receive 201 policy created
PUT /api/v1/patient/insurances/:id with updated policy data -> Receive 200 updated policy -> DELETE /api/v1/patient/insurances/:id -> Receive 200 or 204 policy removed
POST /api/v1/patient/insurances with invalid providerId or expired card image -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/v1/patient/insurances without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Insurance Requests
features.description: Lets patients review insurance pre-authorization or claim-related requests linked to appointments or services.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/insurance-requests with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with insurance request list -> GET /api/v1/patient/insurance-requests/:id -> Receive 200 with request details and status

GET /api/v1/patient/insurance-requests/:id for a request owned by another patient -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/patient/insurance-requests without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Files
features.description: Provides a central patient file repository for uploaded documents such as medical attachments and supporting files.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/files with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with file list -> POST /api/v1/patient/files with multipart upload -> Receive 201 file stored and returned
POST /api/v1/patient/files with unsupported file type -> Receive 400 file validation error -> GET /api/v1/patient/files without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Appointments
features.description: Supports browsing upcoming and past appointments, booking for self or family, session access, and lifecycle actions such as cancel and reschedule.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/appointments/upcoming with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with upcoming appointments -> POST /api/v1/patient/appointments/book/personal with doctorId, slot, and booking data -> Receive 201 appointment created -> GET /api/v1/patient/appointments/:id -> Receive 200 with appointment details -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/appointments/:id/reschedule -> Receive 200 with updated schedule

POST /api/v1/patient/appointments/book/family with familyMemberId and valid slot -> Receive 201 appointment created for dependent -> GET /api/v1/patient/appointments/:id/session -> Receive 200 with session info when appointment is confirmed and remote -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/appointments/:id/cancel -> Receive 200 canceled appointment

POST /api/v1/patient/appointments/book/personal with insurance booking but no saved insurance policy -> Receive 400 business-rule error -> GET /api/v1/patient/appointments/:id/session before confirmation -> Receive 403 or 409 session not available -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/appointments/:id/reschedule after completion -> Receive 400 invalid status transition

features.name: Bookings
features.description: Returns a list of patient bookings across appointments and related booking records.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/bookings with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with booking history
GET /api/v1/patient/bookings without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Home Services
features.description: Allows patients to request home healthcare services, inspect request details, and cancel pending requests.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/home-services with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with home service requests -> POST /api/v1/patient/home-services with address, preferred date, and notes -> Receive 201 request created -> GET /api/v1/patient/home-services/:id -> Receive 200 with request details -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/home-services/:id/cancel -> Receive 200 canceled

POST /api/v1/patient/home-services with missing address or invalid preferred date -> Receive 400 validation error -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/home-services/:id/cancel for a completed request -> Receive 400 or 409 cannot cancel finalized request

features.name: Doctors Search
features.description: Enables patients to search doctors, view doctor details, and inspect availability before booking.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/doctors/search with Bearer accessToken and search filters -> Receive 200 with matching doctors -> GET /api/v1/patient/doctors/:id -> Receive 200 with doctor profile -> GET /api/v1/patient/doctors/:id/availability -> Receive 200 with available slots

GET /api/v1/patient/doctors/search without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/patient/doctors/:id for an unavailable or invalid doctor -> Receive 404 not found or 403 not bookable

features.name: Specializations
features.description: Shows specializations and specialization-linked doctor lists for discovery and booking.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/specializations with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with specialization catalog -> GET /api/v1/patient/specializations/:id -> Receive 200 with specialization details -> GET /api/v1/patient/specializations/:id/doctors -> Receive 200 with doctors in that specialization
GET /api/v1/patient/specializations without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/patient/specializations/:id/doctors for an invalid specialization -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Sub-Specializations
features.description: Returns the list of sub-specializations used for finer-grained doctor discovery.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/sub-specializations with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with sub-specialization list
GET /api/v1/patient/sub-specializations without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Services
features.description: Lets patients browse available service types such as remote, home, or clinic services and inspect service detail pages.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/services with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with service catalog -> GET /api/v1/patient/services/:id -> Receive 200 with service details
GET /api/v1/patient/services/:id with invalid service id -> Receive 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/patient/services without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Directories
features.description: Provides general directory browsing for platform-supported clinical and operational reference data.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/directories with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with available directories
GET /api/v1/patient/directories without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Medical Records
features.description: Exposes prescriptions, reports, and x-rays with list, detail, PDF, and result retrieval endpoints.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/prescriptions with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with prescription list -> GET /api/v1/patient/prescriptions/:id -> Receive 200 with prescription details -> GET /api/v1/patient/prescriptions/:id/pdf -> Receive 200 with downloadable PDF

GET /api/v1/patient/reports with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with report list -> GET /api/v1/patient/reports/:id/pdf -> Receive 200 with report PDF -> GET /api/v1/patient/x-rays/:id/pdf -> Receive 200 with x-ray PDF or file preview

GET /api/v1/patient/prescriptions/:id for a record not owned by the patient -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/patient/reports/:id/pdf without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/patient/x-rays/:id/results for an invalid id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Conversations
features.description: Supports patient conversation threads, message retrieval, message sending, and read acknowledgements.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/conversations with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with conversation list -> POST /api/v1/patient/conversations with appointment context -> Receive 201 conversation created -> GET /api/v1/patient/conversations/:id/messages -> Receive 200 with message history -> POST /api/v1/patient/conversations/:id/messages -> Receive 201 message sent -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/conversations/:id/messages/:messageId/read -> Receive 200 message marked read

POST /api/v1/patient/conversations/:id/messages without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/patient/conversations/:id/messages for a conversation not belonging to the patient -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found

features.name: Call Sessions
features.description: Provides appointment-linked call session information for remote consultations.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/call-sessions/by-appointment/:appointmentId with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with call session join information for the appointment

GET /api/v1/patient/call-sessions/by-appointment/:appointmentId for a non-remote or unconfirmed appointment -> Receive 409 session unavailable or 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/patient/call-sessions/by-appointment/:appointmentId without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Payments
features.description: Lets patients initiate payments and review payment history and payment details for appointments or home services.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/patient/payments/initiate with valid payable reference -> Receive 201 or 200 with payment intent/record -> GET /api/v1/patient/payments -> Receive 200 with payment history -> GET /api/v1/patient/payments/:id -> Receive 200 with payment detail

POST /api/v1/patient/payments/initiate with invalid booking reference -> Receive 400 validation or business-rule error -> GET /api/v1/patient/payments/:id for another user's payment -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/patient/payments without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Support
features.description: Provides support contact information and ticket management, including ticket creation, detail views, and threaded replies.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/support/info with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with localized support contact information -> GET /api/v1/patient/support/tickets -> Receive 200 with the patient’s tickets -> POST /api/v1/patient/support/tickets with category, subject, description, and optional attachments -> Receive 201 ticket created -> GET /api/v1/patient/support/tickets/:id -> Receive 200 with ticket details -> POST /api/v1/patient/support/tickets/:id/messages -> Receive 201 reply posted

POST /api/v1/patient/support/tickets with more than 5 attachments -> Receive 400 attachment limit error -> GET /api/v1/patient/support/tickets/:id for another user's ticket -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/patient/support/info without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Settings
features.description: Allows patients to view and update account settings and app preferences.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/settings with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with current settings -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/settings with updated preferences -> Receive 200 with saved settings
PATCH /api/v1/patient/settings without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/settings with invalid preference values -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Provides the patient notification inbox and read-state management.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/notifications with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with notification list -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/notifications/:id/read -> Receive 200 marked as read -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/notifications/read-all -> Receive 200 all notifications marked read

GET /api/v1/patient/notifications without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> PATCH /api/v1/patient/notifications/:id/read for a notification not owned by the patient -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found

features.name: Lab Tests
features.description: Lets patients browse lab test requests, inspect request details, download PDFs, and upload result files.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/patient/lab-tests with Bearer accessToken -> Receive 200 with lab test request list -> GET /api/v1/patient/lab-tests/:id -> Receive 200 with lab test detail -> GET /api/v1/patient/lab-tests/:id/pdf -> Receive 200 with downloadable PDF -> GET /api/v1/patient/lab-tests/:id/results -> Receive 200 with uploaded result metadata

POST /api/v1/patient/lab-tests/:id/results with multipart file upload -> Receive 201 result created -> GET /api/v1/patient/lab-tests/:id/results -> Receive 200 showing completed result -> GET /api/v1/patient/lab-tests/:id/pdf -> Receive 200 updated PDF if available

POST /api/v1/patient/lab-tests/:id/results with unsupported file type -> Receive 400 file validation error -> GET /api/v1/patient/lab-tests/:id for another patient's request -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/patient/lab-tests without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
